single.rationale: Robert Half exhibits severe deterioration across all key metrics with revenue declining 25% over three years and operating margins collapsing from 12.4% to 1.4%. While the staffing industry is cyclical, the company faces structural headwinds including AI-enabled automation displacing contract talent and prolonged weakness in hiring activity. Despite strong FCF generation and share buybacks, the trajectory suggests continued pressure in a sluggish labor market.
